verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce documents agent-specific network tokens in place of raw card numbers. Purchase-intent mandates carry a declineThreshold amount and an effectiveUntilTime expiry. Credential retrieval must declare merchant and amount, and VisaNet enforces that authorizations come from the intended merchant for the correct amount. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the limits are enforced in production, and general availability (docs say the product is 'in the process of development and deployment').

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can hand my agent a scoped, limited-use payment credential — amount limits, expiry, merchant restrictions — instead of a raw card number

citations.quote: A new pass-through payment token, specific to agents, that is intended for use at Visa-accepting merchant locations.
required mandates fields declineThreshold (amount, currencyCode), effectiveUntilTime, mandateId, and description
When authorization requests are received by VisaNet, controls will be enforce to ensure that the request originates from the intended merchant for the correct amount.
required fields include "merchantInformation.merchantName", the merchant descriptor URL, and "orderInformation.amountDetail.totalAmount"
Capture consumer consent, set spending limits, and manage mandates for agent-initiated payments.
